title: Statue of Liberty 3D Scan
author: Metron3D
modifications: Welded duplicate mesh seams and reduced from 1,035,539 to 90,000 triangles. Oriented and normalized, then leveled the scanned pedestal by its measured base plane; flattened only the bottom contact strip. Original textures removed; atlas patina, stone, gold and display base added.

levelCorrection.method: Area-weighted normal of the bottom pedestal surface; minimal rigid rotation to world up, with the lowest 0.01-unit contact strip flattened onto the display base.
